title: your brain is LYING to you 🧠 | part 5
description: Try fact one right now. You will fail. Part 6 tomorrow.
hook: Your brain is lying to you right now.
facts: You cannot hum while holding your nose closed. You just tried it.
Walking through a doorway can make you forget why you came. It's called the doorway effect.
The voice reading this in your head? Your brain invented it.
You cannot tickle yourself. Your brain cancels the surprise.
Deja vu might be your brain double checking its own memory.
outro: Follow for part six. Your brain will deny everything.
